notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content: [p]Roomballs just got a huge update! Tons of bugs have been fixed and Lobbies have been replaced by rooms. Now it's much easier and more flexible to create, join, and leave rooms, switch teams, start or cancel matches, and more. The distance filter has been removed, but the room list now shows info like FPS, distance, and host ping. The room creator can assign players to each team and make changes at any time. Spectator mode has also been added. You can now see how many players are online globally and in your country. Please download the update, try it out, and let us know what you think. Enjoy![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041409/dc01bc0a3cd2bc5ad646614b1cde1bb6f08552ec.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041409/0e8d2611f5062beae51a04e925d0c245380fcdb9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: News Scroller and Nearby Chat added
notes.content:
I’ve just added two new features to Roomballs to help players connect and stay informed!

The first is a News Scroller at the bottom of the main menu. I’ll use it to share updates, tips, and anything that might help improve your experience in the game.

The second is a Nearby Chat. This feature lets you send and read messages from other players within a 4,000 km radius — basically, an 8,000 km wide circle with you at the center. It works like a public board where you can coordinate times to play with people near you and increase your chances of finding matches.

Let me know if you think this is a good idea or if you have any suggestions. We need to grow and connect the Roomballs community — otherwise, the game doesn’t make sense.

See you in the arena!

notes.title: 🎉 Exciting News! Roomballs is now on Steam! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We are thrilled to announce that Roomballs is officially visible on Steam!

At Ultraton Studios, we have poured our hearts and souls into this project, and we can't wait for you to join us on this incredible journey.

Roomballs is a unique blend of soccer and air hockey, featuring zany robots inspired by your favorite pop culture icons. This game is not just about speed and strength; it's about strategy, quick moves, and clever plays. We guarantee endless fun and high-octane action!

We invite you to follow our progress, share your thoughts, and support us as we work towards our dream of launching Roomballs for everyone to enjoy. Together, we can make this game something truly special.

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to step into the arena and show the world who’s the champion!

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm!

Ultraton Studios Team
